title: WPSS/1836/2013 of Mahendra Singh Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 1836/2013 (S/S)
Mahendra Singh ÖÖÖ Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand & Others ÖÖÖ. Respondents
Mr. DS Mehta, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. HM Raturi, Addl. CSC, for the State of Uttarakhand.
29th November, 2013

Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
 Petitioner Mahendra Singh is a Teacher in
Government Inter College, Paundha, Dehradun. Learned
Counsel for the petitioner apprised this Court that the
petitioner was initially appointed as a CT Grade Teacher
in the year 1990 in that very college. In the course of
time, he was promoted as a LT Grade Teacher, but he
remained in the same college.
2. Now, under compulsory transfer scheme,
petitioner was transferred on 18.6.2013 from
Government Inter College, Paundha, Dehradun to
Government High Secondary School, Bhergaon,
Jayharikhal, District Pauri Garhwal. Bhergaon comes
under the category of remote area. After issuance of his
transfer order, the petitioner did not join his new place of
posting. Rather, he preferred a representation before the
competent authority, who after hearing him and
considering the grounds stated in his representation,
altered the place of his transfer to Government Higher
Secondary School, Maletha, Dehradun. Petitioner still did
not comply with the new transfer order and made
another representation before the Director of Education
on 19.10.2013. In that representation, he stated that his
wife is suffering with sundry serious ailments and that he
has attained the age of 55 years on 31.5.2013.

2
3. Learned Counsel for the petitioner has argued
that in the new transfer policy, those teachers who have
attained the age of 55 years have been absolved from the
transfer. This contention is totally baseless and is
rejected for the reason that as per Rule 26 of the said
policy, it was incumbent upon the petitioner to first join
at his new place of posting and then to prefer an appeal
before the competent authority. However, instead of
doing so, he has avoided compliance of his transfer
orders on one pretext or the other. He did so even after
the earlier place of his posting, which happened to be a
remote area in District Pauri Garhwal, has been changed
to Maletha in District Dehradun. He has been working for
the last more than 22 years in the same Inter College in
Dehradun.
4. In the abovenarrated facts and circumstances,
I find no merit in this petition. It is dismissed summarily.
